_readme: Elpida charges and prices every launch in each chain's native coin. Edit the numbers below, then apply them:
Solana:  node scripts/native-pricing.mjs --chain solana-devnet --yes   (or solana-mainnet, solana-localnet)
EVM:     open the site as the launchpad owner, pick the network and press 'Apply native pricing'.
All amounts are whole coins (SOL, ETH, BNB), written as strings.
launchFee  creation fee paid by the creator to the treasury on every launch, whatever the pair.
startFdv   fully diluted value of a new token at launch (price x 1B supply).
endFdv     Solana only: FDV at which the curve completes and migrates (SOL pair: Raydium).
EVM curves have a fixed shape and complete at 16 x startFdv.
New values apply to launches made after the change. Tokens already launched keep the values they launched with.
Mainnet values are examples: set them from the current coin price before deploying.
